identity.title: Two Control Room Envelope HVAC Trains Inoperable Resulting in a Condition That Could Have Prevented Fulfillment of a Safety Function

cause.proximate_text: The causes of the TCM failure were excessive equipment vibration conditions and age-related degradation of the electrolytic capacitors in the TCM panels. ... Cancellation of an existing preventative maintenance activity failed to evaluate the impact of the change to an existing 10-year requirement on aging of electrolytic capacitors internal to the TCMs.
cause.theme: Vibration-induced TCM degradation compounded by inadequate causal analysis, Maintenance Rule implementation, design change review, and PM cancellation

Excessive equipment vibration on TCM due to lightly loaded chiller fluid stall
nodes.description: When multiple Essential Chillers are in operation and one is in a slightly loaded condition, that chiller is susceptible to fluid stall which creates high vibrational load to the chiller, attached hardware, and TCM panels.

nodes.display_name: Age-related degradation of electrolytic capacitors in TCM
TCM failure - unable to maintain chiller outlet temperature
nodes.description: The failure of the TCM resulted in the inability to maintain Essential Chiller 22B outlet temperature between 42 and 48 degrees Fahrenheit.

chain: excessive vibration + age-related capacitor degradation [cause TBD] -> TCM failure on Chiller 22B -> chilled water outlet temp oscillation / vane & bypass valve cycling -> Essential Chilled Water Train B inoperable -> CRE HVAC Train B inoperable (cascading) + CRE HVAC Train C already inoperable for maintenance -> only 1 of 3 CRE HVAC trains OPERABLE (15h24m), potential inability to fulfill safety function
notes: FORM-366 fields provided no plant_name/unit/reactor_type/cause_code; plant/unit/reactor type inferred from narrative (South Texas Project Unit 2, PWR) and docket 05000499. Cause code left TBD/provisional per official field despite narrative identifying four detailed apparent causes; theme captures the compound nature (vibration + capacitor aging + inadequate causal analysis/Maintenance Rule/design review/PM cancellation) without overriding the official TBD code. Block 13 system/component codes taken from Section II.D (KM/23/B350/TCM-1A); cause field there is not explicitly given so set to TBD to match header. No stated operable backup system for CRE HVAC trains during the event (Train A presumably operable but not explicitly stated as such in narrative) so no BACKED_UP_BY edge asserted. Previous similar events: six references listed in narrative; supplement LERs (2023-003-01, 2024-002-01) omitted as they revise/duplicate the -00 versions already captured as stubs with SIMILAR_TO; only distinct original event LER numbers were modeled to avoid redundant stub nodes for supplements of the same event.
